svg.title: Coordinated nonrelational recovery topology
svg.desc: Topology showing global application traffic, Cosmos DB multi-region writes, GZRS Blob Storage, a secondary region, and backup and restore validation.

g.aria-label: document reads and writes: traffic to cosmos-primary
asset reads and writes: traffic to blob-primary
multi-region write replication: cosmos-primary to cosmos-secondary
GZRS object replication: blob-primary to blob-secondary
document recovery exercise: cosmos-secondary to restore-proof
object recovery exercise: blob-secondary to restore-proof
Service node: Backup and restore proof

svg.text: Global application traffic uses multi-region document writes and durable object replication while recovery evidence covers both stores.
